hypothesis: A small unleveraged Bitcoin ETP substitution improves the actual balanced portfolio rather than merely adding risky exposure.
selection_reason: US-dollar Nasdaq spot Bitcoin trust fits the current USD SMART stock/ETP adapter; selected for execution fit, not a return ranking. No alternative issuer search.
execution: Shared engine, actual product OHLC only, next-session opening fills, whole shares, existing 20% relative no-trade band and $100 minimum notional. Bitcoin sleeve monthly target, held between updates; netted trades may occur on core rebalance dates. Target is not a hard drift cap.
costs: Fixed-style $0.005/share, $1 minimum; IBIT 2bp half-spread, existing trailing ADV impact; double all execution costs on core and primary. Fund expenses embedded in product prices, not deducted twice.
cash: Zero interest on positive idle cash; BIL returns embedded. No leverage, borrowing, shorting, derivatives or direct cryptocurrency custody. Dated DGS3MO rates benchmark excess returns.
data: Reuse core Parquet/rate hashes from E2; download only IBIT into separate ignored storage. Freeze input hashes before portfolio scoring. No spot-price backfill or pre-inception returns.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular block bootstrap of excess-Sharpe improvement using total-return volatility. The short product record cannot establish multi-cycle reliability.

decision: Keep all eight results. Failed frozen point criteria reject this expression; passing point criteria with intervals crossing zero is inconclusive, not proof. Even a favorable result permits further raw-price/venue/shadow review only, never automatic paper or live promotion.
venue: Read-only paper-account contract qualification and trading-hours/order-type discovery only. No orders, what-if submissions, cancellations, restarts or permissions changes. Contract discovery does not prove live-account permission or liquidity at an opening auction.
limitations: Product and broker pages incidentally expose current performance before freeze; historical data is not an untouched holdout
Less than three years of actual product history; no 2008/2020/2022 crypto-ETP stress validation
Adjusted-price whole-share research proxy; raw corporate actions and historical executable quotes unverified
ETF market-hours closure creates weekend and overnight Bitcoin gap exposure
USD pretax, no CAD conversion or account-specific withholding/tax model
Not a test of all Bitcoin strategies, a trend-filtered crypto sleeve, ETH or a historical spot implementation
Paper contract discovery is not live-account admission; Complex or Leveraged ETP permission category does not itself imply this product uses leverage
